Lane B (lane name: inbox-71-2): ROOT-WAKE ADDRESSING, THE DURABLE RECORD, AND THE UP-FRONT REPORT for issue #564. Read the shared-context entry root-wake/contract first; it is the frozen interface and the evidence table.

TARGET
- impl/src/wake-stream.mjs: the new class row.
- impl/src/swarm-runtime.mjs: the three producers + the delivery record + the undelivered attention row.
- impl/src/application-deployment.mjs: the rootWake declaration validation + the doctor section.
- New test file: impl/test/root-wake-red.test.mjs.
- Do not edit the new impl/src/root-wake.mjs (lane A owns it): import its frozen interface. If it is not on your tree yet, import it by the frozen names anyway and note the dependency in needsFromOthers.

CHANGE
1. WAKE CLASS ROW (wake-stream.mjs WAKE_CLASS_TABLE, one class per ledger row - the table's own invariant): wakeClass 'root_waiting', scope 'deployment', terminal true, address 'root' (a new additive field on wakeRow - carry it through wakeClassTableRows() so the docs/CLI help render it), next 'baton swarm view {swarmId}', summary 'work is waiting on the root and no other seat can settle it', rows [ledgerKind('swarm.root_waiting')], subject {field:'itemKind', kind:'root_waiting', fallback:{field:'swarmId', kind:'swarm'}}. Register 'swarm.root_waiting' in swarm-state.mjs's admitted kinds beside the other swarm rows with its payload validation (itemKind closed on 'review' | 'needs_from_others' | 'seat_holding', refs non-empty).
2. THREE PRODUCERS (durable, one swarm.root_waiting row per owed item, dedup read from existing rows - never a clock):
   - needs_from_others: at a swarm.contribution_recorded append, scan payload.body.needsFromOthers[] for a word-boundary /\broot\b/i match; mint {itemKind:'needs_from_others', contributionId, matchedText, itemIndex}. Record the matched text in the row - the evidence for why it fired.
   - review: the existing cadence is the fold's own crossing of an unreviewed contribution by a LATER swarm.participant_joined (swarm-runtime.mjs:4391-4430 builds the unreviewed_contribution attention row from that crossing). On that same crossing, compute the eligible reviewer set = ACTIVE participants whose permissions include 'review', excluding the author. When the set is EMPTY, mint {itemKind:'review', contributionId, authorParticipantId} - the root is the only eligible reviewer. When it is not empty, mint nothing (the existing row already pages the author).
   - seat_holding: the swarm.resume_decision_requested write (swarm-runtime.mjs:8614) - when the asking participant's row has parentId === null (a top-level seat: its orchestrator IS the root), mint {itemKind:'seat_holding', participantId, predecessor} beside it.
3. DELIVERY + RECORD + ATTENTION: for each NEW root_waiting row, attempt delivery through deliverRootWake (frozen; import from ./root-wake.mjs) with the deployment's declared target; then record the outcome once as its own durable row: 'swarm.root_wake_delivered' {itemKey, harness, channel, sent, at} on success, 'swarm.root_wake_undelivered' {itemKey, harness, reason} on failure. itemKey = the item's identity (contributionId / participantId + itemKind). A second pass for the same itemKey must find the existing record and not re-attempt. Tests inject the delivery seam.
4. UP-FRONT REPORT: 
   - a rootWake section on doctorReadiness(): {target, harness, channel, wakeable, mechanism|reason, undelivered: [...]} derived from the declaration + the channel table + the undelivered rows. A deployment with no declaration says so (state 'no root wake target declared'), never an empty healthy-looking object.
   - the deployment summary/view carries the same section so a harness that cannot be woken is visible at recruit time (the operator's words: 'never discover it by silence').
   - an attention row kind 'root_wake_undelivered' in the deployment/attention fold so an undelivered root wake is attention the deployment view reports.
5. DECLARATION: advanced.rootWake = {harness, sessionRef} validated at open beside advanced.services (application-deployment.mjs:6258-6261 is the closed-field pattern); an absent section is legal (nothing declared), a malformed one refuses at open with the deployment's own typed error.
6. RED-FIRST rows (each fails before the change, passes after): B1 the class is in WAKE_CLASSES with scope deployment, terminal, address root; B2 a swarm.root_waiting row derives the root_waiting class through wakeClassFor; B3 each of the three producers mints its row (one fixture each); B4 the review producer fires ONLY when the eligible-reviewer set is empty (a second active seat with review permission suppresses it); B5 exactly-once: a second evaluation of the same item does not mint a second row nor a second delivery record; B6 undelivered -> the record row + the attention row; B7 delivered -> the record row, and the doctor's rootWake section names the harness, channel and that it is wakeable; B8 an undeclared target -> doctor says 'no root wake target declared'; B9 a malformed declaration refuses at open; B10 the existing unreviewed_contribution attention row still pages the author when an eligible reviewer exists (no regression).

ACCEPTANCE
- node --test test/root-wake-red.test.mjs from impl/ green, with the counts before and after recorded; the adjacent suites you touch stay green (wake-stream.test.mjs, swarm-wake.test.mjs, swarm-projections.test.mjs, issue356-wake-frame.test.mjs, doctor suites) - run only the files you need, targeted.
- Publish one contribution with the closed shape; carriedForward names what is still open (live per-harness turn-starting evidence is lane A's table; the delivery attempt is only exercised with injected seams here).

CONTEXT: your lane branch baton/ws-31990608ddf858acf2c5cafeb8e26521 is at 02033dc4 with #71 accepted and runner-clean; commit this lane's work on top of it. Do not integrate, do not push.
